description: This PHP source file defines a helper class '_parse_propfind' for parsing PROPFIND request bodies in a WebDAV server context. It handles XML parsing of input files related to WebDAV operations, particularly parsing the properties requested in a PROPFIND request.

classes.name: _parse_propfind
classes.description: A helper class for parsing PROPFIND request XML bodies in a WebDAV server context. It reads an input file, parses XML tags related to WebDAV properties, and exposes the result state and properties requested.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes parsing state, opens the input file, and processes the XML content to extract WebDAV properties requested.

methods.name: _startElement
methods.description: Handler for the start of an XML element; updates internal state based on specific WebDAV tags like 'allprop' or 'propname'.

methods.name: _endElement
methods.description: Handler for the end of an XML element; decrements the nesting depth counter.
